title: Panel schedule
description: A panelboard and its circuits. Known fields are typed; extra fields are allowed.

manufacturer.description: Panel manufacturer chosen in the New-panel picker (e.g. Square D, Eaton), from js/lib/panel-catalog.js.

line.description: Breaker line within the manufacturer (e.g. Homeline, QO, BR, CH).

breakerFamily.description: The breaker-part generator key for the line (QO, HOM, BR, CH, Q, THQL, THQP), or null for a blank/proprietary panel. Drives the slot-fill part number (js/lib/breaker-partnumbers.js).

breakerWidth.description: Breaker frame width class for the line.

tandemsMode.description: How the line accepts tandems: 'all' freely, 'marked' only in slots the label marks (CTL), 'none' not at all. Gates the Tandem/Quad affordances. Absent means 'all' (blank/legacy panel).

quad.description: Whether the line supports a space-saver quad. false hides the Quad affordance; absent means allowed (blank/legacy panel).

poles.description: Number of poles (1, 2 or 3). With half='B', poles=2 marks a quad (space-saver) inner 2-pole: it occupies this space's lower half and the next space's upper half, leaving the two outer halves free for single-pole breakers.

half.description: Half-space position: 'A' (upper) or 'B' (lower) for a tandem; absent/null for a full-space breaker. A 'B' half with poles=2 is a quad inner 2-pole that spans into the next space's 'A' half.

breakerType.description: Breaker type. 'tandem' is a single half-space breaker; 'quad' marks the inner handle-tied 2-pole of a space-saver quad (with half='B' and poles=2).

colorOverride.description: A phase key (A/B/C) to force the swatch colour, a #rrggbb row-highlight colour, or the literal 'none' to suppress the purpose-derived highlight.

purpose.description: Free purpose tag; 'smoke' and 'alarm' get the smoke-alarm highlight by default.

status.description: Fill-as-you-go wiring progress; empty means not tracked.

partNo.description: Breaker catalogue/part number for this circuit. Auto-resolved from the panel's breakerFamily and the circuit's poles/amps/type, or a manual override (see partNoManual). Fed to the per-panel breaker list / material takeoff.

partNoManual.description: True when partNo was edited by hand; a manual value wins and is never overwritten by the auto-resolver.
